subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Sounds and Spelling – Unit 4, Lesson 7: Graded readers
outcomes: I can read a story aloud with a partner.
I can find words with ee, er, ar and o-e in a story.
I can answer questions about "The goat herd" and "Where Is Our Shark?".

tf.s: In "The goat herd", the boy puts his boots on his feet.
tf.why: Yes! I put my boots on my feet.

tf.s: In "The goat herd", the boy can see goats and bees.
tf.why: Great! I can see goats. I can see bees.

tf.s: In "Where Is Our Shark?", a girl and her grandma are in the park.
tf.why: Well done! They are in the park at the start.

tf.s: The note says the shark is in its home in the zoo.
tf.why: The note says the shark is NOT in its home.

tf.s: There is a shark in the lake.
There is a duck in the ferns.
tf.why: It is a cat in the ferns.

tf.s: Shark, park and dark have the ar sound.
Some and have are tricky words in "The goat herd".
tf.why: Yes! We learn them by heart.

boxes.q: I put my ___ on my feet.
boxes.why: I put my boots on my feet.
In the story: I can see goats.
In the story: I can see bees.

boxes.q: Circle the tricky word: I have some goat food.
boxes.why: Some is a tricky word (have is one too).

boxes.q: Where do the girl and grandma find the note?
boxes.why: They find the note in the park.

boxes.q: Who is with the girl in the park?
boxes.why: A girl and her grandma are in the park.

hunt.q: The girl is in the park with…
They find it in the park.
The shark's home is in the…
In the lake there is a…
In the ferns there is a…

o: Our shark is not in its home in the zoo.
Our duck is in the lake.
Our cat is in the zoo.
mcq.why: The note says the shark is not in its home.

mcq.q: Which word from the shark story has ar?
Which is a tricky word in "Where Is Our Shark?"?
Which animal does the boy see in "The goat herd"?
True or false: The shark is not in its home.
mcq.why: The note says it is not in its home.

mcq.q: Write one sentence from "The goat herd".
o: Our shark is in the zoo.
mcq.why: I can see goats is from The goat herd.

mcq.q: Find the word with the same sound as "shark" in the story.
mcq.why: Shark and dark both have ar.

mcq.q: Can you see a shark in the lake? Why do they say No?
Why do the girl and grandma look for the shark?
o: It is not in its home in the zoo.
mcq.why: The note tells them the shark is not in its home.

mcq.q: Which group has words from both stories with the ee sound?
mcq.why: Feet and bees both have ee.
